script: There is a jellyfish that can turn itself back into a baby. When it is hurt or stressed, Turritopsis dohrnii can change back into a polyp, its earliest life stage. From that polyp, new jellyfish grow that are genetically identical to it. In theory, it can repeat this cycle again and again, which is why it is called the immortal jellyfish. The whole animal is only about 4 to 5 millimeters across. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
